'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Bangladesh measles outbreak]]
**Amidst the ongoing [[measles]] outbreak in [[Bangladesh]], [[Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Bangladesh)|health minister]] [[M. A. Muhit]] says that the outbreak will need 2-3 months for it to be under control. [https://www.jagonews24.com/en/national/news/95309 (Jagonews24)]
**In a study from the [[Bangladesh Shishu Hospital & Institute]], around 82% of children who died from measles during the outbreak in Bangladesh did not receive adequate or exclusive [[breastfeeding]] during their first 6 months of their life. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/health/417833/82%25-of-children-who-died-from-measles-lacked (''Dhaka Tribune'')] [https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health/82-children-who-died-measles-were-not-exclusively-breastfed-study-1519491 (''The Business Standard'')]
**Four more children are reported to have died from measles in 24 hours, bringing the death toll in the country from the outbreak past 922. [https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/health/measles-death-toll-reaches-922-4-more-children-die-24-hours-1519286 (''The Business Standard'')]
*[[Merck & Co.|Merck]] and [[Moderna]] report that their [[cancer vaccine|cancer]] [[vaccine]] candidate showed positive results in their late-stage trial in preventing a [[Cancer recurrence|recurrence]] of [[melanoma]], including in high-risk patients. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260819-merck-and-moderna-s-tailored-cancer-drug-curbs-melanoma-recurrence-in-trial (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/19/moderna-merck-cancer-vaccine-shows-initial-late-stage-melanoma-data.html (CNBC)]
